title: Plumage
fandoms: 名探偵コナン | Detective Conan | Case Closed

additional: meant to be HeiShin but it's pre-relationship

summary:
There are a lot of superstitions surrounding wings, but Shinichi knows the facts: people get their wings by the time they’re twenty-five and they’re based on the birds that exist in the world. Any other ‘facts’ are generalities, details Shinichi memorizes, but knows not to take as truth.
For example, it’s rare for people to get wings before the age twelve, but not impossible. Shinichi is one of them, developing them at the tender age of four. Young enough that at seventeen his wings are an extension of himself.
He can’t imagine a life without them. He’s used to their weight, their heft, the way they affect his balance. He knows his own feathers from just a touch. He has his molting schedule memorized to a tee. He knows how to shift them just so to pull off a perfect bicycle kick in a soccer match. Not to be arrogant, but Shinichi can control them precisely too, he doesn’t jump and fluff, not like the newly winged do.
When Shinichi transforms into Conan, he has to learn how to handle his wings all over again. Not because of his age, but because his wings have changed.
Wings aren’t supposed to change.
